blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Local anomaly detection is the task of identifying spatially confined anomalous or out-of-distribution (OOD) regions within an otherwise in-distribution (ID) image. Most existing methods are designed for a specific context, with a strong focus on industrial defect detection, where they achieve excellent performance on well-established benchmarks. However, we observe that these methods can exhibit significant performance drops in other contexts, especially when the inlier distribution is multimodal. To account for this inlier complexity, we propose LACToS, a principled local OOD detection method based on statistical typicality and made tractable through two innovations: (i) grouping pixels into superpixels and (ii) using a computationally efficient proxy to estimate typicality. We evaluate LACToS across three diverse applications spanning medical imaging, human faces, and X-ray security screening. LACToS performs more robustly than prior methods across these benchmarks. The code is released here: https://github.com/voilalab/LACToS.
blocks.zh: 局部异常探测是确定空间限制异常或分布外区域在否则的分布内图像的任务。 现有方法大多是针对具体情况设计的,重点突出工业缺陷检测,在既定基准上取得优异成绩. 然而,我们发现,这些方法在其他情况下,特别是在最优惠的分销是多式联运的情况下,表现会显著下降。 为了考虑到这种更为复杂的情况,我们提出LACTOS,一种基于统计典型性的原则性局部OD检测方法,并通过两个创新使这个方法可以应用:(一) 将像素组合成超像素和(二) 使用计算效率的代词来估计典型性. 我们评价LACTOS的三种不同应用,包括医疗成像、人脸和X光安全检查。 对照这些基准,LACTOS的绩效比以往的方法要强。 该代码在此发布:https://github.com/voilalab/LACTOS.

blocks.en:
Local anomaly detection is the task of identifying out-of-distribution (OOD) regions that are spatially confined within an otherwise in-distribution (ID) image.
It is central to applications such as industrial defect inspection, medical image analysis, and security screening, where an anomalous region may occupy only a small fraction of the image yet indicate a defect, tumor, or weapon.
Unlike image-level OOD detection, which assigns a single anomaly score to an entire image, localized pixel-level anomaly detection involves generating a dense heatmap that indicates which pixels or regions of each outlier image are inconsistent with the inlier distribution.
This makes the problem especially challenging: a local OOD detector must be sensitive to subtle local deviations while remaining robust to natural variation in normal image content.
blocks.zh:
局部异常探测的任务是确定在空间上被限制在以其他方式分布的(ID)图像内的分出(OOD)区域.
它对于工业缺陷检查、医疗图像分析和安全检查等应用至关重要,因为异常区域可能只占据图像的一小部分,而表明存在缺陷、肿瘤或武器。
与图像级OOD检测为整个图像分配一个单一的异常分不同的是,局部的像素级异常分检测涉及生成一个密集的热映射,显示每个外部图像的哪一个像素或区域与更强烈的分布不一致.
这使得问题尤其具有挑战性:本地的OD探测器必须对微妙的局部偏差敏感,同时对正常图像内容的自然变化保持强健.

blocks.en:
Prior work on localized anomaly detection has largely followed representation-based and reconstruction-based approaches.
Representation-based methods extract local features from normal (inlier) training images, and score test patches using their distance from the learned distribution or their likelihood under it ( Cohen and Hoshen, 2020 ; Defard et al., 2021 ; Roth et al., 2022 ) .
Reconstruction-based methods instead reconstruct, inpaint, or denoise the target image under a prior for inlier images, and use the discrepancy between the input and its reconstruction as an anomaly signal ( Mousakhan et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2024 ) .
Although both approaches have achieved strong empirical performance, especially for industrial defect detection ( Bergmann et al., 2019 ) , their anomaly scores are often heuristic: representation-based methods depend on the choice of feature and distance metric, while reconstruction-based methods typically collapse the distribution of inlier completions into a point estimate.
Conformal and risk-control methods can provide statistical guarantees for calibrated segmentation outputs ( Shen and Liu, 2025 ) , but they generally rely on a large amount of OOD calibration data.
Moreover, we empirically observe that these methods do not always generalize reliably beyond industrial defect detection.
blocks.zh:
先前关于局部异常探测的工作主要遵循基于代表性和重建的方法。
基于表现的方法从正常(更生)训练图像中提取出局部特征,并用其与所学分布的距离或其下的可能性进行分分测试补丁(Cohen和Hoshen,2020;Defard等,2021;Roth等,2022.).
基于重建的方法转而重建、涂上或将目标图像置于更清晰的图像之下,并将输入与重建之间的差异用作异常信号(Mousakhan等,2024;Wu等,2024)。
虽然这两种方法都取得了很强的经验性能,特别是在工业缺陷检测方面(Bergmann等,2019年),但其异常分数往往具有uristic:基于代表的方法取决于特征和距离度量的选择,而基于重建的方法通常会将更强完成的分布崩溃为分数估计.
形式和风险控制方法可以为校准分解输出提供统计保障(沈和刘,2025),但它们一般依赖大量的OOD校准数据.
此外,我们从经验上观察到,这些方法并不总是可靠地超越工业缺陷探测。

blocks.en:
We present LACToS, a statistical method for local OOD detection that is designed to address these limitations of existing methods. Our approach is fundamentally reconstruction-based, but uses the key insight that the distribution of the reconstructions contains valuable information that is lost when reconstruction error is computed using a single sample or an aggregated point estimate.
To leverage this richer distributional information towards improved local anomaly detection, we propose an anomaly metric based on statistical typicality, a measure of how representative a sequence of observations is for a given distribution.
Our use of typicality is inspired by previous typicality-based OOD detection methods ( Nalisnick et al., 2019 ; Osada et al., 2023 ; Barkley et al., 2026 ) .
However, these works are focused on image-level OOD detection where an entire image is classified as OOD, and to the best of our knowledge, using typicality for local anomaly detection has not yet been explored.
blocks.zh:
我们提出LACTOS,一种用于当地检测OD的统计方法,旨在解决现有方法的这些局限性。 我们的方法基本上是基于重建的,但利用了关键的见解,即重建的分布包含宝贵的信息,这些信息在使用单一样本或汇总点估计计算重建错误时丢失了。
为了利用这种更丰富的分布信息来改进对当地异常现象的检测,我们提出了一个基于统计典型的异常度度量,以衡量某一分布的观测序列如何具有代表性。
我们的典型性使用灵感来自之前的以典型性为基础的OOD检测方法(Nalisnick等,2019;Osada等,2023;Barkley等,2026).
然而,这些作品侧重于图像级的OOD检测,其中整个图像被归类为OOD,而我们所了解的,利用典型的局部异常检测尚未探索.

blocks.en:
We begin with the typicality score of Nalisnick et al. (2019) , and adapt it to identify local rather than whole-image anomalies ( Section 4.1 ).
Instead of asking whether an entire image is typical with respect to the unconditional prior distribution, we ask whether each pixel is typical with respect to the inpainting posterior conditioned on all other pixels in the image.
However, this substitution induces three major challenges: (i) failure to detect larger local anomalies that span multiple contiguous pixels, (ii) loss of statistical validity, because typicality testing requires sampling a sequence of i.i.d. observations, and (iii) prohibitive computational cost of performing posterior sampling separately for each pixel.
blocks.zh:
我们从Nalisnick等人(2019年)的典型性得分开始,并对其进行调整,以识别本地而非全图像异常(第4.1节)。
我们不问整个图像对于无条件的先发后发是否具有典型性,而是问每个像素对于图像中所有其他像素所附带条件的后发后发是否具有典型性.
然而,这种替代引发了三大挑战:(一) 未能发现跨越多个相接像素的较大局部异常,(二) 统计有效性的丧失,因为典型性测试需要采样一个序列即观测结果,(三) 对每个像素分别进行后相采样的高昂计算成本.

blocks.en:
LACToS tackles these challenges through two innovations: we partition images into superpixels and replace pixel-level typicality with superpixel-level typicality ( Section 4.2 ), and we use a single denoising posterior as a common proxy for all inpainting posteriors. Our use of superpixels addresses challenges (i) and (ii), because a local OOD feature is more likely to be captured by a superpixel than a single pixel, and the individual pixels in each superpixel can be treated as independent observations to evaluate superpixel-level typicality. Our use of denoising rather than inpainting addresses challenge (iii), by dramatically reducing the number of posterior samples needed to estimate typicality.
Through these innovations, we show that LACToS achieves strong quantitative and qualitative performance across a wide range of local OOD detection tasks including detecting tumors in CT scans, detecting unusual facial accessories in photographs, and detecting weapons in X-ray baggage scans.
blocks.zh:
LACTOS通过两个创新来应对这些挑战:我们把图像分割成超像素,并用超像素级的典型来取代像素级的典型(第4.2节),我们使用单一去诺化后作来作为所有涂入后作的共同代名词. 我们使用超像素解决了挑战(一)和(二),因为一个局部的OOD特征比单个像素更容易被超像素所捕捉,每个超像素中的单个像素可以作为独立观测来评价超像素水平的典型. 我们使用去名而不是去名来对付挑战(三),办法是大幅度减少估计典型性所需的后采样数量。
通过这些创新,我们显示,LACTOS在一系列广泛的当地OOD检测任务中,包括CT扫描中检测出肿瘤,在照片中检测出非同寻常的面部配件,并检测出X射线行李扫描中的武器,实现了强大的数量和质量性能.

blocks.en:
To summarize, we propose LACToS, a statistical approach to local OOD detection in images using an inlier diffusion model and typicality testing. Our method (1)
is grounded in statistical typicality, and (2) is competitive with, and often more precise than, existing methods across diverse local OOD detection tasks with complex inlier distributions.
blocks.zh:
概括地说,我们提出LACTOS,一种使用更强扩散模型和典型性测试在图像中进行局部OD检测的统计方法. 我们的方法(1)
其基础是统计的典型性,而(2) 具有竞争力,而且往往比现有方法更精确,这些方法涉及各种不同的当地OD检测任务,其分布更为复杂。

blocks.en:
In LACToS, we treat a diffusion model as an oracle denoiser that samples images consistent with its training distribution and a noisy input image.
We provide a brief introduction to diffusion models and their use in posterior sampling in Appendix A .
Here, we provide context on local OOD detection methods proposed in prior work, some of which inspired our use of statistical typicality in LACToS.

我们在附录A中简要介绍了传播模型及其在后取样中的使用。
在这里,我们提供了先前工作中提出的当地OD检测方法的背景,其中一些方法启发了我们在LACTOS中使用统计典型.

OOD detection is studied at both the image and pixel (local) levels.
Image-level OOD detection assigns a single anomaly score to an entire image, with the goal of identifying images that are not drawn from the inlier distribution seen during training.
In contrast, we focus on pixel-level OOD detection, in which the goal is to produce a dense anomaly heatmap to localize anomalous regions within each image.
Formally, given an image x ⋆ x^{\star} , the goal is to estimate the ground truth anomaly mask m ⋆ m^{\star} .

Many of these works, especially those using diffusion models, are reconstruction-based: they generate an in-distribution reconstruction of the input using posterior sampling and use discrepancies such as ℓ 1 \ell_{1} , ℓ 2 \ell_{2} , SSIM ( Wang et al., 2004 ) , LPIPS ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) , or feature-space distances as anomaly scores ( Zavrtanik et al., 2021 ; Wu et al., 2024 ; Mousakhan et al., 2024 ; Pirnay and Chai, 2022 ) .
Although effective, these methods often collapse the distribution of plausible reconstructions into a first-order statistic, such as the mean reconstruction error, which does not capture the full reconstruction distribution and can reduce robustness to complex inlier distributions.

blocks.en:
The local OOD detection problem has been extensively studied in the context of industrial defect detection.
Prior works such as PatchCore ( Roth et al., 2022 ) , EfficientAD ( Batzner et al., 2024 ) , GLASS ( Chen et al., 2024 ) , and diffusion-based DDAD ( Mousakhan et al., 2024 ) achieve excellent performance on widely used benchmarks such as MVTec AD ( Bergmann et al., 2019 ) and VisA ( Zou et al., 2022 ) .
However, we observe that these methods do not extend robustly to other OOD detection tasks, such as tumor detection, facial anomaly detection, and security screening using X-ray images, as shown in Table 1 .
One potential cause of this brittleness is the complexity of the inlier distribution.
Industrial defect-detection datasets often have very structured inlier distributions, as products without defects are visually near-homogeneous, whereas CT scans, images of human faces, and X-ray baggage scans are far more heterogeneous even in the absence of anomalies.
Moreover, defects in products are context-agnostic: a defective feature, such as a crack or fracture, is anomalous regardless of where in the image or product it occurs.
In contrast, a dark region in a CT scan may be innocuous normal anatomy in one location, or indicative of a tumor in another.
blocks.zh:
结合工业缺陷检测,广泛研究了当地的OD检测问题.
之前的作品有"帕奇科雷"(Roth等,2022年),"高效AD"(Batzner等,2024年),"GLASS"(Chen等,2024年)等以传播为基础的DDAD(Mousakhan等,2024年),在MVTec AD(Bergmann等,2019年)和"VisA"(Zou等,2022年)等被广泛使用的基准上取得了出色的成绩.
但是,我们观察到,这些方法并没有有力地推广到其他的OD检测任务,例如肿瘤检测、面部异常检测以及使用X光图像的安全检查,如表1所示。
造成这种不便的一个潜在原因是更紧密的分布的复杂性.
工业缺陷检测数据集往往有结构化的更强的分布,因为没有缺陷的产品是视觉近同位素的,而CT扫描,人相图和X射线行李扫描即使在没有异常的情况下也更加相异.
此外,产品中的缺陷是上下文不可知的:一个有缺陷的特征,如裂缝或断裂,无论在图像或产品中发生在哪里,都是异常的.
相形之下,CT扫描中的黑暗区域可能是一个位置的无害的正常解剖学,或者指向另一个位置的肿瘤.

blocks.en:
Specifically, when the conditional distribution over a local region given the rest of the image is multimodal, methods that rely on a first-order statistic may erroneously identify samples from a different inlier mode as anomalous.
To illustrate this phenomenon through a toy experiment, we construct four inlier distributions with increasing complexity levels, and train a diffusion model on each inlier distribution. Each image contains four shapes, one per quadrant.
In the upper-right quadrant, every inlier image contains a circle, which allows us to define all other shapes placed in that quadrant as local anomalies.
The other three quadrants can contain a wider variety of shapes, as shown in the top row of Figure 2 , with the candidate shapes at each level occurring with equal probability. From level 1 to level 4, the set of shapes that can be placed in these three quadrants progressively grows, which increases the number of modes of the inlier distribution.
We then introduce local anomalies in test images by replacing the top-right circle with a square, and evaluate two baseline methods, DDAD ( Mousakhan et al., 2024 ) and PatchCore ( Roth et al., 2022 ) , on how well they can correctly identify only the square as an anomaly.
The bottom row of Figure 2 demonstrates that at a per-image true positive rate (TPR) of 95 % \% , the false positive rate (FPR) increases with inlier multimodality for both baseline methods. This trend holds across the TPR values shown in Figure 7 .
For more information on the experimental setup, please refer to Appendix B .

blocks.en: 4 Method
blocks.zh: 4 方法

blocks.en:
To tackle this problem, we propose LACToS, a typicality-based pixel-level OOD detection method using diffusion models, which is much more robust to inlier multimodality.
In Section 4.1 , we first describe an idealized extension of an existing typicality-based metric for image-level OOD detection to pixel-level anomaly localization, and several issues that limit its direct application. Then, in Section 4.2 and Section 4.3 we introduce two key techniques, superpixels and a denoising proxy, that help overcome these issues and allow for an effective and tractable approximation to pixel-level typicality. In Section 4.4 , we additionally incorporate extracted pixel-level features which can provide more informative statistical context than color alone.
blocks.zh:
为了解决这一问题,我们提出LACTOS,一种典型的以像素水平为单位的OOD检测方法,使用扩散模型,它更能增强多模式性。
在第4.1节中,我们首先描述了将图像级OOD检测的现有典型度量表理想化扩展至像素级异常局部化,以及限制其直接应用的几个问题. 然后,在第4.2节和第4.3节中,我们引入了两种关键技术,即超像素和去名代用技术,这些技术有助于克服这些问题,使像素水平的典型性得到有效而可拉动的近似. 在第4.4节中,我们补充了提取的像素级特征,这些特征可以提供比仅用颜色更丰富的统计背景。

Unfortunately, this direct extension of typicality to conditional distributions in Equation 4 is not a practical score for anomaly detection for the following reasons. (P1) Due to the spatial locality of pixel intensities and the smoothness of natural images, the value of a pixel given all others is often strongly constrained by nearby pixels.
With conditional distributions that are concentrated on a tiny set determined by the neighboring pixels, the typicality score is unlikely to capture OOD features that span multiple adjacent pixels. (P2) In addition, a single pixel value is a sequence of length 1, which is insufficient for the theoretical guarantees of typical sets ( Equation 2 ) to hold.
Indeed, the typicality test of Nalisnick et al. (2019) has been shown to exhibit poor empirical performance on single samples ( Chauhan et al., 2022 ) . (P3) It is also computationally demanding to compute the anomaly heatmap A A by approximating Equation 4 , as f inp ​ ( x ⋆ , j ) f^{\mathrm{inp}}(x^{\star},j) has to be evaluated for every pixel j ∈ 𝒥 j\in\mathcal{J} . blocks.en:
Although superpixel-level typicality reduces the required number of posterior samples from | 𝒥 | ​ N |\mathcal{J}|N to | 𝒦 | ​ M |\mathcal{K}|M , the cost remains prohitive for fine superpixel partitions.
For instance, Figure 3 shows a 256 × \times 256 image partitioned into 2,600 superpixels (approximately 25 pixels per superpixel on average), which would require a total of at least 2600 posterior samples using a diffusion model.

blocks.en: 5 Evaluation
blocks.zh: 5. 评价

blocks.en: We evaluate LACToS on three local anomaly detection datasets spanning medical imaging, human faces, and X-ray security screening ( Table 4 ). In each case, the diffusion model in LACToS is trained only on ID images, and all methods are evaluated on a held-out test set. Each test set includes an equal number of ID images and images containing local OOD features.
blocks.zh: 我们根据三个地方异常检测数据集对LACTOS进行评估,这些数据集涵盖医疗成像、人相和X光安全检查(表4)。 在每一种情况下,LACTOS中的传播模型都只接受ID图像的培训,所有方法都通过停放测试集进行评估. 每个测试集包含相同数量的ID图像和包含本地OOD特征的图像.

blocks.en:
CHAOS ( Kavur et al., 2019 ) provides abdominal CT scans of healthy patients. We train on 3,070 inlier slices and construct a test set containing 100 healthy test slices and 100 locally anomalous slices acquired by adding synthetic tumor to each.
Following common practice in CT image analysis ( Wang et al., 2021 ; Thummerer et al., 2023 ; Su et al., 2019 ) , we apply the provided body mask at evaluation to exclude background pixels. FFHQ ( Karras et al., 2019 ) is a dataset of high-quality face images, which we treat as the inlier distribution. We train on a random subset of 5,000 images, and manually curate an OOD test set of 50 photographs of movie and television characters with prosthetics or atypical facial features (e.g., scars, metal implants), verified not to overlap with FFHQ. The ID test set contains 50 randomly selected held-out FFHQ images. DVXray ( Ma et al., 2024 ) is a dataset of X-ray luggage scans, with an ID set of weapon-free bags and an OOD set containing weapons. We train on 5,000 inlier images and restrict the OOD test set to the scissors category, where targets are small and spatially confined.
For randomly sampled scissor images, we used SAM 3 ( Carion et al., 2026 ) to convert the dataset’s bounding-box annotations into segmentation masks, manually discarding images with visibly inaccurate masks for a final OOD test set of 72 images. We construct an ID test set that also contains 72 images, none of which contains a weapon.

blocks.en: We compare LACToS against six strong baselines developed for industrial defect detection, spanning representation- and reconstruction-based methods. PatchCore ( Roth et al., 2022 ) builds a coreset-subsampled memory bank of ID patch features from a frozen ImageNet-pretrained backbone and scores test patches by nearest-neighbor distance. SimpleNet ( Liu et al., 2023 ) learns a feature adapter and a discriminator that separates adapted ID features from synthetic anomalies generated by injecting Gaussian noise in feature space. SuperSimpleNet ( Rolih et al., 2024 ) extends SimpleNet with architectural and training improvements for fast, reliable surface defect detection. EfficientAD ( Batzner et al., 2024 ) combines a lightweight student–teacher model with an autoencoder to detect local structural anomalies and violations of global logical constraints through feature discrepancies. GLASS ( Chen et al., 2024 ) trains a discriminator to separate ID features from synthetic anomalies generated using gradient ascent with truncated projection in feature space and local texture overlays in image space. DDAD ( Mousakhan et al., 2024 ) conditions a denoising diffusion model on the test image to produce an ID reconstruction and scores anomalies by feature-space discrepancy.

blocks.en: Each method produces a heatmap of anomaly scores per test image. Following standard practice, we pool pixel-level anomaly scores across all test images and evaluate three complementary pixel-level detection metrics. AUROC captures the relative ordering of heatmap values against the ground-truth anomaly mask, but can reward low-contrast heatmaps that flag many ID pixels as nearly as anomalous as the true OOD pixels. AP summarizes precision across recall levels, weighting each precision value by the corresponding increase in recall. AUPRO is the normalized area under the per-region overlap curve up to a false positive rate of 0.3 0.3 , where per-region overlap is the fraction of correctly detected pixels within each connected ground-truth anomalous region, averaged equally across regions. When different anomalies have different sizes, AUPRO weights all anomalies equally rather than overweighting large anomalies.

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en:
We present LACToS, a framework for general-purpose local anomaly detection.
We leverage a pretrained diffusion model to represent the inlier distribution, and combine it with a statistical approach that scores image regions by their typicality (or rather, atypicality) under the conditional distribution induced by their surrounding context.
Empirically, LACToS shows strong performance across diverse local OOD detection tasks ranging from medical imaging to security screening.
blocks.zh:
我们提出LACTOS,这是当地通用异常探测的框架.
我们利用预先经过训练的传播模型来代表较强的分布,并将其与统计方法结合起来,在周围环境诱导的有条件分布下,以图像区域的典型性(或者说非典型性)来评分.
从经验上讲,LACTOS在从医学成像到安全检查等各种当地OD检测任务中表现出了强大的性能.

blocks.en:
We note that since LACToS is more robust to inlier multimodality, it is also less likely to flag features from minority inlier modes as anomalous, especially when using a larger M M .
We demonstrate this behavior through a toy experiment, and refer interested readers to Appendix C .
It is possible that some features annotated as anomalies in the benchmarks we evaluate may be similar to features present with low frequency in the inlier (training) datasets, causing LACToS to classify them as inliers and thus generate false negative predictions according to the dataset anomaly labels.
We therefore advise practitioners that, in order to maximize the accuracy of LACToS, it is important to ensure that the training set does not contain the anomalies one desires to detect.
blocks.zh:
我们注意到,由于LACTOS更强而使多式性更强,它也不太可能将少数型多式的特征标出为异常特征,特别是在使用更大的MM时。
我们通过一个玩具实验来展示这种行为,并将感兴趣的读者参考附录C。
有可能,在我们评价的基准中被附加为异常的一些特征可能类似于在更低频(训练)数据集中存在的特征,导致LACTOS将其归类为更低频,从而根据数据集异常标签产生虚假的负面预测.
因此,我们建议从业人员,为了最大限度地提高LACTOS的准确性,必须确保培训集不包含人们想要发现的异常现象。

blocks.en:
Since LACToS targets general-purpose local anomaly detection, specialized approaches can outperform LACToS for specific highly structured datasets, such as those common in industrial defect detection. Please refer to table 7 for evaluation on MVTec AD Bergmann et al. (2019) .
LACToS inherits the computational cost of diffusion posterior sampling, which is significantly higher per-image than feedforward representation-based methods such as PatchCore.
LACToS also relies on Assumption 4.1 , which may be violated when superpixels are large or when the anomalous region spans multiple superpixels with heterogeneous pixel statistics.
LACToS requires several hyperparameters, such as the noise variance in the denoising posterior sampling, the quantization granularity and smoothing bandwidth in the histogram estimation, the number of posterior samples, the granularity of superpixels, and the spatial smoothing variance of the final heatmap. While we provide ablation studies showing LACToS is fairly robust to these hyperparameters, future work may find mechanisms to remove or automatically set optimal parameter values across tasks. Future work may also replace our histogram estimation with a learned or parametric density model, or extend our LACToS framework to video and 3D data types where spatiotemporal or volumetric superpixels could provide longer sequences for improved typicality estimation.
blocks.zh:

LACTOS继承了扩散后采样的计算成本,这种成本比PatchCore等以饲料为主的表达法,每个图像明显地高.
LACTOS还依赖于Assumption 4.1 ,当超像素大或异常区域跨多个超像素并有多像素统计时,可能会被违反.
LACTOS 需要多个超参数,如去诺氏后期采样中的噪声差异,直方图估计中的分量颗粒度和平滑带宽,后期采样数量,超像素颗粒度,以及最终热映射的空间平滑差异等. 虽然我们提供的开发研究显示LACTOS对这些超参数相当强大,但未来的工作可能会找到各种机制去除或自动设定跨任务的优化参数值. 今后的工作还可以用一个有学问或参数密度模型来取而代之的直方图估计,或者将我们的LACTOS框架扩大到视频和3D数据类型,其中spatientmpor或proptertic超像素可以提供较长的序列来改进典型性估计.

Using these diffusion models, we evaluate how the multimodality of the inlier distribution affects the performance of different local anomaly detection methods.
We generate 50 test images that contain a square on the upper-right corner, and place other inlier shapes at the other corners.
We label the pixels in the square as positive (anomalous), and all others as negative (non-anomalous).
For DDAD Mousakhan et al. (2024) , each test image is noised then denoised, which is used in conjunction with ResNet embeddings of the image to construct the anomaly heatmap. We also evaluate a variant of DDAD that uses more samples by repeating the noising-then-denoising process 20 times with different random seeds, averaging the denoised samples, and using the resulting average to construct the anomaly heatmap.
For PatchCore Roth et al. (2022) , a feed-forward model is trained for each inlier distribution, and a heatmap is generated by evaluating the test image with the feed-forward model.
Finally, for LACToS, we follow the process described in Section 4 , while varying the sample count from 1 to 20.
Since the images are grayscale, we use the same set of parameters as for CHAOS, the dataset containing abdominal CT scans which are also in grayscale, for all methods.

On the other hand, the inlier probability of a square being placed in the other 3 corners is progressively lowered from 0.5 0.5 to 0.1 0.1 .

另一方面,在其他三个角落放置一平方的概率从0.5.0.5逐渐降低到0.1.0.1.

The upper-right corner, marked with a red box, always contains a circle. blocks.en:
To verify the hypothesis, we measure two quantities.
First, we measure the AUROC over pixels that belong to ID squares and circles, where squares are labeled positive and circles are labeled negative.
A higher AUROC here means the method treats ID, but potentially under-represented, squares differently from ID circles, and vice versa.
Second, we measure the AUROC over pixels that belong to squares, where OOD squares (those at the upper-right corner) are labeled positive and ID squares (those at other corners) are labeled negative.
Higher AUROC here means that the method treats the under-represented ID squares differently from truly OOD squares, and vice versa.
In Figure 9 , we observe that LACToS is less likely to distinguish ID squares from ID circles and more likely to distinguish under-represented ID squares from truly OOD squares compared to DDAD.
Both trends become more apparent with increasing number of sampled reconstructions.
Together, these results verify our hypothesis, and inform practitioners that LACToS is a more reliable choice when one wishes to detect features that are not included in the training set without falsely flagging uncommon inlier features.
blocks.zh:
为了验证这个假设,我们测量出两个量.
首先,我们用属于ID正方形和圆形的像素来测量AUROC,其中正方形被标记为正方形,而圆形被标记为负方形.
这里更高的AUROC表示方法处理ID,但可能代表不足,平方与ID圈不同,反之亦然.
第二,我们用属于正方形的像素测量AUROC,OD正方形(位于右上角的正正方形)和ID正方形(位于其他角的正方形)的正方形.
这里更高的AUROC表示该方法将代表不足的ID平方与真正的OOD平方区别对待,反之亦然.
在图9中,我们观察到LACTOS不太可能区分ID圆形的ID正方形,与DDAD相比,更可能区分代表不足的ID正方形和真正的OD正方形.
随着抽样重建数量的增加,这两种趋势都变得更加明显。
这些结果一起验证了我们的假设,并告知从业者,LACTOS是一个比较可靠的选择,当人们想要检测那些没有被包含在训练集中的特征而不错误地标出异常更强烈的特征时.

blocks.en: Figure 9: LACToS Toy Experiment 2. AUROCs across different inlier square probabilities, over methods and different sample sizes. (Left) AUROC is computed over pixels that belong to inlier squares and circles, with those pixels from squares labeled positive, and negative otherwise. Higher AUROC means the method is more likely to distinguish an inlier square (minority) from inlier circles (majority). (Right) AUROC is computed over pixels that belong to squares, with those pixels from the square in the upper-right corner (truly OOD) labeled positive, and negative otherwise (minority inlier). Higher AUROC means the method better distinguishes an inlier but uncommon square from a strictly out-of-distribution square.

Once M M reconstructions are computed and the corresponding features are acquired, we rescale RGB values from [ 0,255 ] [0,255] and
autoencoder outputs from [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] to a common [ 0,255 ] [0,255] range.
Then, we partition the reconstructions and feature maps into superpixels containing an average of S avg S_{\mathrm{avg}} pixels each, using marker-controlled watershed segmentation ( Meyer and Beucher, 1990 ) .
For each superpixel, we quantize the rescaled values into B RGB B_{\mathrm{RGB}} and B feat B_{\mathrm{feat}} bins per dimension, for RGB values and autoencoder outputs respectively.
While it is ideal to construct C + C f ′ C+C^{\prime}_{f} -dimensional histograms, the number of histogram bins grows exponentially with the dimension.
Therefore, we construct two empirical histograms per superpixel, one over RGB values and one over feature values.
We smooth each histogram with a
Gaussian kernel of σ hist \sigma_{\mathrm{hist}} to mitigate empty bins under limited
samples, and use the histograms to compute the RGB and feature typicality scores for each superpixel.
The two scores are summed with a weight parameter λ \lambda multiplied to the feature typicality to balance the trade-off between the two scores.
Finally, we smooth the anomaly map that contains the same value over all pixels in each superpixel to acquire the pixel-level anomaly map.
All parameters are selected by performing a grid search over a small subset containing 20 test images, and the configuration with the highest AUROC is used to evaluate over the full test set.
The specific parameters used for each benchmark can be found in Table 5 .

blocks.en: E.5 Feature extractor and autoencoder
blocks.zh: E.5 地物提取器和自编码器

blocks.en: The feature extractor ϕ \phi is an ImageNet-pretrained ResNet-101 He et al. (2016) , frozen at all stages. We extract activations from the last three residual stages, upsample them to the input resolution, and concatenate them. To reduce histogram error under limited samples, these features are compressed to C f ′ = 3 C^{\prime}_{f}=3 dimensions by a per-pixel autoencoder trained on each inlier dataset.
blocks.zh: 特性提取器-\\phi是一款由ImageNet预置的ResNet-101 He等(2016年),在所有阶段被冻结. 我们从最后三个剩余阶段中提取活化物, 把它们做成输入分辨率的样本, 并将其合成. 为了减少有限样品下的直方图误差,这些特性被压缩为C f = 3 C^{\prime}_{f}=3维,通过在每个更高级的数据集上训练的每像素自编码器.
